title: Compact Keep Learning & Adaptive Carousel
changes: Compressed the completed-route Keep Learning section into horizontal cards on mobile to reduce vertical scrolling.
The Keep Learning row now uses concise cards for Another Mission, Reviews and Practice with subtle page indicators.
On wider desktop layouts, the three Keep Learning options display side by side.
Added clear headings to the study-mode cards: Japanese Journey and Japan Ready.
Improved Journey / Japan Ready interaction by input type: touch swipes, trackpad native scroll, mouse click, keyboard arrows/Enter, and wide desktop side-by-side cards.
Retains the mobile partial-card peek pattern so users naturally discover horizontal swiping without instructional text.
Retains all v11.7.1 performance improvements and v11.7 learning feedback features.
Bumped release-controlled assets and service-worker caches to v11.7.2.
